verdict.rationale: The documented APIs cover most of the domain lifecycle: availability search, registration with quotes, DNS CRUD, WHOIS contacts, transfer lock, renewals, forwarding, transfers, auctions and notifications. Commerce stores, catalog, orders, customers and tax are also exposed, all backed by OpenAPI specs, PAT auth and a CLI. However, no evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and other product areas are not evidenced as API-accessible. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for non-domain/non-commerce products (hosting, email, SSL, website builder), account/billing management via API, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
